points.what: LATAM orders rose 40.2% to 122, contributing 35 of the 26-order increase, or 134.6% of the total change.
points.so_what: LATAM alone more than accounts for the week's order growth, as APAC, North America and EMEA each edged down about 1%.

points.what: Email orders grew 31.4% to 46 and Display 47.8% to 34, each contributing 11 orders, or 42.3% of the change.
points.so_what: Two of the smallest traffic sources supplied most of the week's order growth.

points.what: Search, at 69.9% of orders, was flat at 598 orders, up 0.3% and contributing just 2 orders.
points.so_what: The largest source held steady, so the week's movement came from smaller channels rather than the core.

points.what: AOV fell 5.2% week on week to $83.03 from $87.59, though it remains 5.3% above last year's $78.83.
points.so_what: Orders grew 3.1% while revenue grew only 1.1%, so the lower average order value held revenue back.

points.what: The cancellation rate fell 2.8 pp to 13.6% from 16.4%, a notable move, but sits 1.2 pp above last year's 12.4%.
points.so_what: Each percentage point of cancellations is worth about $710 of revenue in the week.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the mature week of 09 Mar 2026 was 9.5%, up 0.3 pp on the prior week but 1.6 pp below last year.
points.so_what: Return behaviour remains better than a year ago, and this rate never refers to the reporting week.

points.what: New signups rose 10.3% to 236, a notable increase, but were 3.7% below last year's 245.
points.so_what: Customer acquisition is not growing in line with orders, which were up 83.1% year on year.

points.what: Q1 closed at $715,557 against a full-quarter target of $774,555, an attainment of 92.4%.

points.so_what: Order quality was mixed: fewer cancellations helped revenue, while the smaller average basket worked against it.

points.so_what: Signups are the one KPI not keeping pace with the 75% growth the targets assume.

points.what: All three months of the quarter finished behind target: January 88.0%, February 92.4% and March 97.7%.
